steps.caption: Automations live under More → Automations. They run by themselves every few minutes.
Check now runs them immediately instead of waiting.
Each automation can be turned off or on here.
This one watches leases: when a notice date or expiry comes close, it starts.
Zentrix's notice deadline is near, so it proposed a requirement — and is waiting for you.
A new requirement, prefilled from the lease. Unknowns are left blank.
Edit proposed values if something needs changing before you approve.
Or ask to clarify, or reject — the automation then stops here.
On its next check, the automation carries on by itself.
Back in Automations: every step is listed with what it did.
It matched alternative buildings and compared renewing vs moving.
And it added a task for you.
The task also appears on Today and in Tasks; the comparison is in Deal toolkit.
